headline: High-risk data leakage and cascading-error paths exist because Airbyte can move business data broadly while ChatGPT Desktop reads files, clipboard, screenshots, and app context by default.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Airbyte can expose pipeline outputs over its API and broad network egress, while ChatGPT Desktop ingests clipboard, files, screenshots, and app context. That creates a plausible instruction-in-content bridge if Airbyte-produced text is copied or surfaced into ChatGPT. The pathway is not proven by docs alone, so I choose medium over low because the shared content bridge is realistic.
conditions: IF Airbyte outputs are copied into ChatGPT Desktop via clipboard or file upload
IF ChatGPT Desktop treats imported content as instructions rather than data
mitigations: Disable clipboard-based transfer between the tools
Paste Airbyte output into a plain-text buffer first and strip instructions
Use a fixed prompt template that tells ChatGPT to treat imported text as untrusted data
Review any Airbyte-generated text before it enters ChatGPT
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between systems

B_data_leakage.rationale: Airbyte touches business data and has broad network egress, while ChatGPT Desktop reads uploaded files and files from supported macOS apps and sends requests to api.openai.com. If the same business data is moved from Airbyte into ChatGPT Desktop, sensitive content can leave the local environment to a third-party API. This is a default-dangerous exfiltration path, so high is warranted.
conditions: IF business data from Airbyte is uploaded or pasted into ChatGPT Desktop
IF ChatGPT Desktop processes that content through api.openai.com
mitigations: Do not send Airbyte exports to ChatGPT Desktop
Redact sensitive fields before any transfer
Use synthetic sample data for analysis
Restrict ChatGPT Desktop to non-sensitive workspaces
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on file and clipboard transfers

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airbyte can call APIs and move data broadly, while ChatGPT Desktop can read files and app context but cannot write files or modify git state. There is overlap on mutable data handling through external systems, but not on direct filesystem or git writes. The conflict is therefore real but bounded, so medium fits better than high.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same upstream API-backed dataset
IF one agent's API-side changes are assumed to be immediately reflected in the other's view
mitigations: Assign one tool as the source of truth
Freeze writes while the other agent reads
Use separate staging and production datasets
Manually reconcile conflicting outputs before applying changes
requires-engineering: add locking or optimistic concurrency controls

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airbyte can generate transformed business data, and ChatGPT Desktop can read files and app context that may contain those outputs. If ChatGPT treats Airbyte-produced artifacts as authoritative without verification, errors can cascade into downstream analysis or user-facing content. Because ChatGPT has no direct autonomous action authority here, medium is more appropriate than high.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop uses Airbyte-generated files or screenshots as factual ground truth
IF no human or automated verification step checks the transformed data
mitigations: Require source-link citations for any derived claim
Compare outputs against the original Airbyte export
Use a second-pass validation prompt
Limit ChatGPT to summarization, not decision-making
requires-engineering: add automated schema and consistency checks

E_compliance.rationale: Airbyte handles business data, while ChatGPT Desktop processes uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and app data through a vendor-mediated service with api.openai.com. If regulated business data is routed from Airbyte into ChatGPT Desktop, retention and residency obligations may diverge. The profiles do not specify a concrete jurisdiction mismatch, so medium is the highest supportable severity.
conditions: IF regulated business data from Airbyte is sent into ChatGPT Desktop
IF the organization requires a retention or residency policy different from OpenAI's service defaults
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of ChatGPT Desktop
Use de-identified extracts only
Confirm retention settings before upload
Document the approved data classes for each tool
requires-engineering: formalize a data-processing agreement and residency review
